$comment: Interim data layer: n8n Data Tables (no credentials needed). Created 2026-09-24 in project uFcEmgtYEFyGauyy on https://ryan1515.app.n8n.cloud. The Postgres/Supabase migration in database/migrations is the long-term target; column names match. Phase 2 (2026-09-25) added the workflow id map below.

ceo_leads.purpose: One row per lead (contact + company + current status). Dedupe key = lead_key.

ceo_messages.purpose: Every inbound message and every AI draft reply (direction inbound/outbound, status received/draft/draft_pending_approval/withheld/sent).

ceo_agent_runs.purpose: Observability: one row per agent invocation (agent, model, provider, input ref, output JSON, success, latency, execution id).

ceo_tasks.purpose: Follow-ups and approval requests for humans (requires_approval flag).

ceo_audit_logs.purpose: Status transitions and other state changes with actor + reason.

github.$comment: n8n GitHub OAuth credential used to read the Obsidian vault at run time and to write lead/company notes into it
